# SES v2

Render and inspect email workflows without sending external mail.

**Status: implemented subset.** Operation selection does not imply complete input or behavior parity.

| Contract | Current implementation |
| --- | --- |
| Service ID | `sesv2` |
| Signing name | `ses` |
| Wire protocol | REST JSON |
| API version | `2019-09-27` |
| Scope | Account and region |
| Execution | Recorded delivery |
| Selected operations | 24 of 116 in the pinned model |

## Implemented behavior

- Identities are verified immediately; templates and configuration sets are stored.
- SendEmail and bulk email validate senders and render a Handlebars subset.
- Delivery records contain messages; configuration set events reach SNS, EventBridge and Firehose.
- Mailbox simulator addresses generate bounce/complaint behavior.

## Limitations and future work

- No SMTP or real outbound email delivery.
- SES v1 is not registered.
- Identity verification is immediate; template rendering and sending limits are local approximations.

These gaps describe current boundaries and possible follow-up slices. The [roadmap](../roadmap/index.md)
separates proposed work from registered functionality; there are no promised release dates.
